metadata.datasource: FUJIFILM Professional Data Guide AF3-207U (2005), printed p. 82 (PDF p. 41): vector paths of the spectral sensitivity and the 135 D-76 small-tank characteristic curves; development table p. 75 (D-76, 20 C, EI 400: 7 1/2 min).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 388-649 nm: the "Spectrogram to Daylight (5400K)" ("Relative Sensitivity (log)", one decade per grid interval) with a 5400 K black body divided out (ASSUMED source spectrum, as Acros II); ASSUMED held below 388 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0566 dex/nm above 649 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.79..2.35 (D-76 small tank, 20 C, 7 1/2 min (the sheet's own time; G-bar 0.54): 7.5 min, interpolated between the plotted 7.5 and 8.75 min curves; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.506); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.355 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: SHEET ISO 400 + LIT: 0 = log10(0.8/400)+1.0 = -1.699 log lux-s
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0061 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
